findings.check: 2.4 window boundaries are written once and are strict at as_of

findings.check: 2.5 unknown categorical level is deterministic and finite
findings.result: 5 unseen levels -> code -1, scored without error, probabilities in [0.122, 0.926]; -1 is NOT a trained level so its logit is the left-most path, not a learned effect
findings.action: map unseen levels to an explicit 'OTHER' level at serving time

findings.check: 2.6 feature ordering is positional, not by name
findings.result: reversing the column order does not change the score — the model is positional, so any serving path MUST build the frame in the metadata's feature order
findings.action: serving code must use metadata['features'] order explicitly
